## Problem and change

Describe the user problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or discussion if there is one.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. State which checks were not run and why. For UI changes, include sanitized evidence when useful.

## Data and compatibility

Describe any changes to stored records, migrations, backups, permissions, command identities or external integrations. Write "None" if there are none.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Existing theme values and UI patterns are reused where applicable.
- [ ] Verification results and remaining limitations are accurately reported.
- [ ] No credentials or private user data are included.
